The '''Vriichon brothers''' were siblings of the [[Ranat/Legends|Ranat]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who were the original owners of [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Cantina]], before selling it to a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]. During the time that they owned the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], the brothers were running an illegal [[Spice/Legends|spice]] den there. The two brothers vanished shortly after selling the cantina to [[Chalmun/Legends|Chalmun]], possibly because they were fearful of the Wookiee discovering the many bodies that were stored in the basement.
